title: Epic: photos on any trip, read from Immich
body:
## Context

Design: [docs/PHOTOS.md](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md). Every trip, past or future, shows the photos its travellers took, read from each family member's Immich library (one per person, built by the sister project Darkroom, which never talks to Waypoint). Waypoint keeps a reference per photo (asset id, time, place, match) and streams pixels from Immich through its own routes.

Nothing is special-cased for one trip: the long road trip that motivates this is a trip with many stays and rentals, and a weekend flight works the same way.

Conventions that bind every issue below: [AGENTS.md](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/AGENTS.md) (one issue, one session; decisions belong in the issue; `make check` before pushing; no comments or docstrings; outbound calls only through `waypoint.tls`; every new route typed in `waypoint/server/contract.py`, listed in the feature map, held by `tests/test_every_route.py` and described in `docs/src/content/docs/`).

## Scope

- Owner gates first: {{PHOTOS-SPIKE}} verifies the Immich API on the family server, {{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}} settles thresholds and behaviour, {{PHOTOS-DESIGN}} signs off every screen.
- Backend: {{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}} (tables and the one migration), {{PHOTOS-PROVIDER}} (`providers/immich.py`), {{PHOTOS-MATCH}} (pure matcher and itinerary fallback), {{PHOTOS-SOURCES}} (key storage and the sources API), {{PHOTOS-SYNC}} (the job), {{PHOTOS-API}} (trip photos, clusters, review and owner actions), {{PHOTOS-PROXY}} (thumbnail, preview and original streaming with access checks), {{PHOTOS-TRIPSTATS}} (per-trip figures), {{PHOTOS-DEMO}} (demo data so `make verify` works without Immich).
- Web app, after design sign-off: {{PHOTOS-UI-SETTINGS}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-GALLERY}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-MAP}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-STATS}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-REVIEW}}.

## Out of scope

Editing, albums, faces, uploads, sharing links, photos in the offline copy, photos over `/mcp`, map tiles, Darkroom itself.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every child issue is closed by a merged PR, or closed with a reason in a comment.
- [ ] `docs/PHOTOS.md` reflects what was built (each PR that departs from it edits it in the same PR).
- [ ] A fresh demo (`python run.py demo`, then `make verify`) shows photos on at least one past trip and one with inferred locations, with no network.

## Tests

Each child issue carries its own; the epic adds none.

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on; Times are where they happen; Private data in logs. Each child names the check it adds.

## Depends on

nothing

## Model

n/a (tracking issue).

title: Spike: verify the Immich API against the family server
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Immich as verified](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#immich-as-verified) lists what the public API docs (v1.140 reference) say and what still has to be checked on the owner's server. The provider ({{PHOTOS-PROVIDER}}), the schema ({{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}}) and the sync ({{PHOTOS-SYNC}}) all depend on these answers.

The owner provides a read-only API key (`asset.read`, `asset.view`) for one library and the server address for the session. The key is used from the agent's shell only and never written into the repository, the issue or the PR.

## Scope

- Answer, with the exact request and a trimmed, anonymised reply shape (field names and types, no asset ids, no coordinates, no file names) pasted into a comment on this issue: (1) the server version (`GET /api/server/about` or `/version`); (2) `POST /api/search/metadata` with `takenAfter`/`takenBefore`, `withExif`, `size: 1000`, `order: asc`, `visibility: timeline`: does `size` 1000 work, what does `nextPage` hold, how long does a page take, and do `takenAfter`/`takenBefore` compare against `exifInfo.dateTimeOriginal` or `fileCreatedAt`; (3) for an asset Darkroom gave an XMP offset, what `exifInfo.timeZone`, `exifInfo.dateTimeOriginal`, `localDateTime` and `fileCreatedAt` contain; (4) whether `updatedAt` changes when a sidecar adds GPS and the library is rescanned (`updatedAfter` is the incremental cursor); (5) `GET /api/map/markers` with `fileCreatedAfter`/`fileCreatedBefore`: fields and speed against the same window; (6) `GET /api/assets/{id}/thumbnail?size=thumbnail` and `size=preview`: content type and pixel size, and whether an external-library asset answers before its thumbnail job ran; (7) `GET /api/assets/{id}/original` for an image and a video: content type and whether the reply streams; (8) the `visibility` Darkroom's assets carry and whether Live Photo videos are separate assets; (9) whether the server is reached over `http://` on the LAN or `https://` through Traefik, and which hostname Waypoint should use; (10) the approximate asset count of the largest library and the count inside the longest trip's window.
- Open a docs-only PR that edits `docs/PHOTOS.md` ([Immich as verified](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#immich-as-verified), the data model's time columns, and the sync's page and budget numbers) to match what was found, and notes any endpoint that behaves differently from the reference.

## Out of scope

Any code under `waypoint/` or `frontend/`. Choosing thresholds (that is {{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}}).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A comment on this issue answers all ten questions, with field names quoted and nothing identifying (no asset ids, coordinates, file names, people or dates of real travel).
- [ ] The docs PR is merged and `docs/PHOTOS.md` no longer says "to confirm in the spike" for anything that was confirmed.
- [ ] The API key used was never committed, logged into the PR or pasted into the issue (`git log -p` on the branch shows no `x-api-key` value).
- [ ] `make check` passes (the docs build is part of it).

## Tests

None (no code).

## Promises and checks

None touched. Personal data in the repo: the comment and PR hold field names and shapes only.

## Depends on

nothing

## Model

Opus: the questions need judgement about what the answers mean for the design, and the write-up changes the design.

title: Decision: photo matching thresholds, overlaps, hiding and sync cadence (owner)
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Decisions for the owner](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#decisions-for-the-owner-proposed-defaults) proposes a default for each choice a user would notice. The matcher ({{PHOTOS-MATCH}}), the API ({{PHOTOS-API}}), the proxy ({{PHOTOS-PROXY}}) and the design ({{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}) read the answers here; per AGENTS.md an agent asks rather than chooses when an issue leaves one open.

## Scope

- The owner answers each item in a comment ("default" is a full answer), then edits the Decisions section of `docs/PHOTOS.md` in a docs-only PR, or asks an agent to.
- 1. Thresholds: `PAD` 12 h, `HOME` 2 km, `NEAR` 100 km, `FAR` 400 km, `MARGIN` 25 km, `GAP` 36 h, `CLUSTER` 5 km.
- 2. A photo inside two overlapping trips: GPS decides when the nearest bookings differ by `MARGIN` or more; otherwise the shorter trip; a tie waits under "Needs a look".
- 3. Hiding: a library's person can hide a photo from a trip and only they still see it; nobody hides someone else's photo. Alternative: no hiding in v1.
- 4. Who sees whose photos: everyone who can see the trip sees every library's photos on it (like bookings and costs). Alternative: only your own library's photos by default.
- 5. Sync: every 6 hours, a full re-list weekly, a Sync now button per source, first run 10 minutes after start.
- 6. Originals through Waypoint (needs `asset.download`), or previews only.
- 7. Videos included, or images only.
- 8. Archived photos skipped (`visibility: timeline`), or included.
- 9. Any signed-in member may connect a library for any person in People (children without a login), or only for themselves.
- 10. `far` photos shown on the trip with a flag, or held back until confirmed.
- 11. Whether "states crossed" from Immich's reverse-geocoded state per photo plus booking addresses is enough, or state lines crossed by the route are wanted (needs data Waypoint doesn't bundle; would be a later issue).

## Out of scope

Visual design (that is {{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}). Anything the spike answers.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every numbered item has an answer in a comment by the owner.
- [ ] `docs/PHOTOS.md`'s Decisions section states each answer as a decision, not a proposal, and the thresholds table shows the chosen values.

## Tests

None.

## Promises and checks

None.

## Depends on

nothing

## Model

n/a (owner). An agent asked to write up the answers: Sonnet (mechanical).

title: Design: trip photos and map (owner sign-off)
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md) (Map and stats, Settings screen, Proxy and access rules) says what each screen shows; this issue decides how it looks. Waypoint's design foundation is `docs/src/content/docs/contributing/design.md` and the specimen page at `#design` (`frontend/src/pages/Design.svelte`): dark only, tokens in `frontend/src/app.css`, kind tiles, status chips, the Sheet, Geist Mono for times.

The existing trip page is `frontend/src/pages/Trip.svelte` with the route replay in `frontend/src/lib/components/RouteReplay.svelte` and `RouteReplayMap.svelte`; Settings sections live in `frontend/src/lib/components/settings/` (`GmailSection.svelte` is the closest pattern to a connection card).

`tools/fleet_checks.py` rejects a raster image committed anywhere but `make verify`'s screenshot folder, the logo catalogue, `waypoint/static/` and `docs/public/`, so approved designs are committed as self-contained HTML or SVG under `docs/design/photos/` (vector only), not PNGs.

## Scope

- Claude produces a mockup as a design artifact, at phone (390 px) and desktop (1280 px) widths, for every new or changed screen: (a) the trip page with the photo strip and the opened gallery, grouped by day, with the inferred-location mark and the `far` flag; (b) the photo viewer (lightbox) with the local time and place, the person whose library it came from, and Open original; (c) the trip map with the route, photo cluster pins (filled for GPS, hollow for inferred, sized by count), a tapped pin, and the replay passing a cluster; (d) the map for a trip that has no replayable route but has photo pins; (e) the trip summary line (days, nights, distance in the household unit, states and countries, photos); (f) Settings, Photos: the source cards (person, host, status chip, last sync, count, Sync now, Change key, Pause, Remove) and the Connect form (person, address, key, Test, Save) with its plain-language note; (g) empty states: no library connected (on the trip page and in Settings), a library connected but nothing synced yet, a trip with no photos, a source that is `refused` or `unreachable`; (h) "Needs a look" for ambiguous and `far` photos with Pick a trip and Hide, wherever the design puts it (under the trip and in the source card are the candidates).
- Each mockup uses the app's tokens and components by name (chip tones, kind tile colours, `text-*` scale, the Sheet on phones) and states the accessible names of new controls.
- The owner comments on the artifacts, Claude revises, and the owner writes "Signed off" on this issue. Then a PR adds the approved designs under `docs/design/photos/` as HTML or SVG files plus a `README.md` that lists them and links back to this issue.

## Out of scope

Any change under `frontend/src/` or `waypoint/`. Copy for the docs page (each UI issue writes its own).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Mockups exist for every screen and state listed in Scope, at both widths, dark only.
- [ ] The owner has written "Signed off" in this issue after the last revision.
- [ ] The approved designs are merged under `docs/design/photos/` as HTML or SVG with a README, and `make check` passes (no raster image outside the places `tools/fleet_checks.py` allows).
- [ ] Each later UI issue can point at one file in `docs/design/photos/` for each screen it builds.

## Tests

None (design artifacts).

## Promises and checks

None. Personal data in the repo: mockups use made-up names, places and dates.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}}

## Model

Opus for the design work (judgement about layout and flow); the owner signs off.

title: feat: photo tables (sources, photos, trip sync windows) and migration 0038
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Data model](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#data-model) defines `photo_sources`, `photos` and `photo_trip_syncs`. Tables are declared in `waypoint/storage/schema.py` (with `info={'doc': …}` and `refers(...)` foreign keys, as `segment_recipients` and `stored_messages` are) and mapped in `waypoint/storage/models.py`. Migrations live in `waypoint/storage/migrations/versions/`, numbered after main's newest (`0037_review_reminder_pref.py` today), and `tools/fleet_checks.py` requires exactly one Alembic head and a `test_<revision>_…` in `tests/test_migrations.py`.

This is the only issue in the epic that adds a migration: every later issue reuses these tables. If the spike changed a time column, change it here.

`docs/PHOTOS.md` lands in this PR if it is not already on main.

## Scope

- Add the three tables exactly as the design's tables say (columns, nullability, defaults, unique constraints, indexes, `ondelete` rules: `photo_sources.person_id` CASCADE, `photos.source_id` CASCADE, `photos.trip_id` and `photos.segment_id` SET NULL, `photo_trip_syncs` CASCADE on both).
- Models `PhotoSource`, `Photo`, `PhotoTripSync` in `models.py`; `AUTO_ID` picks up `photo_sources` and `photos` by itself.
- Migration `0038_photos.py` with upgrade and downgrade; its test in `tests/test_migrations.py` following the file's pattern (replay from the baseline, no drift against `schema.metadata`, shape after downgrade).
- Backups: the three tables are in a backup (none joins `backup.SKIP`); extend the backup round-trip test with a source row whose `api_key` is an encrypted string and check it comes back byte-for-byte (restore never normalises).
- Settings key `PHOTOS_LAST_RELIST` in `waypoint/storage/settings_keys.py` (not a secret).
- Add `docs/PHOTOS.md` (the design) if missing, and a one-line entry for the new tables under the ORM page `docs/src/content/docs/contributing/orm.md` if that page lists tables.

## Out of scope

Encryption registration for `api_key` (`secretbox.SECRET_COLUMNS`, `encrypt_stored`): {{PHOTOS-SOURCES}}. Any route, job or provider code.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `make fleet-checks` passes: one head, `test_0038_photos` present.
- [ ] `tests/test_migrations.py` shows no drift between the migrated database and `schema.metadata` on SQLite, and `make test-pg` passes on a throwaway Postgres.
- [ ] A backup made after the migration restores the three tables with their rows unchanged, including an `enc:v1:` key value.
- [ ] `make check` passes.

## Tests

- `tests/test_migrations.py::test_0038_photos` (upgrade, downgrade, drift).
- `tests/test_backup.py` (or the existing backup suite): round trip of the three tables.
- Both run on Postgres too (`make test-pg`), since this touches the schema (AGENTS.md, "Tests that share the database").

## Promises and checks

None directly; sets up the tables the proxy's and API's visibility checks rely on. Check added: the migration test.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SPIKE}}, {{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).

title: feat: Immich provider (search, markers, thumbnail, original) behind waypoint.tls
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, How it fits Waypoint](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#how-it-fits-waypoint) and [Immich as verified](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#immich-as-verified). `waypoint/providers/flightstatus.py` is the pattern: a `Hosts` dataclass tests can swap, `tls.urlopen` for every request, fixed error classes (`NotConfigured`, `Refused`, `RateLimited`, `Unavailable`), parsing kept separate from fetching so it is tested on fixtures. `waypoint/providers/mailimages.py` is the pattern for reading a body in chunks under size and time caps.

A provider imports no other provider: `pyproject.toml`'s import-linter section says each new provider gets an independence contract naming the others. `.semgrep/waypoint.yml`'s `waypoint-flightstatus-hosts` is the pattern for keeping a service's host in one module; `.semgrep/examples/` holds the deliberately wrong code each rule must flag.

## Scope

- `waypoint/providers/immich.py` with: `Source` (frozen dataclass: `url`, `key`, `allow_http`), `clean_url(text)` (scheme `http` or `https`, host, optional port, no path, no userinfo; returns None otherwise, like `ai.clean_url`), `ping(source)` (`GET /api/server/ping`, and `GET /api/users/me` to report the key's user name and email for the Test button, not stored), `search(source, taken_after, taken_before, *, updated_after=None, page=1)` returning parsed `Asset` records (`id`, `kind`, `taken_utc`, `taken_local`, `taken_offset`, `latitude`, `longitude`, `state`, `country`, `updated_at`) and `next_page`, `markers(source, after, before)` returning `(id, lat, lon)` tuples, `thumbnail(source, asset_id, size)` returning `(content_type, bytes)` under caps, and `open_original(source, asset_id)` returning a response-like object the proxy streams in chunks. Every request sends the key in the `x-api-key` header, a fixed `User-Agent: Waypoint/1`, and `Accept: application/json` or the image types; `timeout` constants at the top of the module.
- Parsing follows the spike's findings for time: `taken_utc` from `exifInfo.dateTimeOriginal` else `fileCreatedAt`; `taken_local` from `localDateTime` cut to minutes; `taken_offset` in minutes from `exifInfo.timeZone` (IANA name resolved at that instant with `zoneinfo`, or `UTC±hh:mm`) or from the offset in `dateTimeOriginal`, else None. Reject an asset with no usable time.
- Errors: 401/403 → `Refused`, 429 → `RateLimited` (with `Retry-After` when given), 404 → `None` for one asset, anything else or a network error → `Unavailable`, with fixed sentences that never include the URL or key.
- `pyproject.toml`: contract `immich-alone` listing `waypoint.providers.immich` with the existing providers; and add `waypoint.providers.immich` to the other providers' independence contracts as `pyproject.toml`'s comment asks.
- `.semgrep/waypoint.yml`: `waypoint-immich-hosts` forbids `/api/search/metadata`, `/api/map/markers`, `/api/assets/` and `x-api-key` outside `waypoint/providers/immich.py`, with examples in `.semgrep/examples/`.

## Out of scope

Decrypting the stored key (the provider takes a plain `Source`; {{PHOTOS-SOURCES}} builds it). Database writes. Any route.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Every outbound call goes through `tls.urlopen`; `make lint` (import-linter `network-through-tls`, `immich-alone`, Semgrep `waypoint-raw-urlopen` and the new `waypoint-immich-hosts`) passes.
- [ ] `search` parses a fixture page with mixed assets (with and without GPS, with an IANA zone, with a `UTC-05:00` zone, with no EXIF, a video) into the record shapes above, and drops an asset without a time.
- [ ] `thumbnail` refuses a body over the cap and a non-image content type, and returns None on a 404; `Refused`, `RateLimited` and `Unavailable` are raised for 401, 429 and a connection error respectively, with messages that contain neither the host nor the key (asserted).
- [ ] `make check` passes, including strict mypy for `waypoint/providers/`.

## Tests

- `tests/test_immich_provider.py`: parsing fixtures (made-up ids and coordinates), error mapping with a patched `tls.urlopen`, `clean_url` cases, and `tests/privacy.py`'s `no_leaks` around a failing request with the key as a canary.
- Semgrep examples for `waypoint-immich-hosts` (positive and negative), run by `make lint`.

## Promises and checks

Private data in logs (fixed error texts, key never in a message). Checks added: the Semgrep rule, the independence contract, the `no_leaks` test.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SPIKE}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).

title: feat: pure photo-to-trip matcher and itinerary location fallback
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Matching](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#matching) specifies the algorithm and the thresholds {{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}} settled. `waypoint/domain/` is fully typed (strict mypy) and the matcher must be a pure function so every branch is tested without a database.

Useful existing pieces: `trips.instant(local, zone)` for instants, `stats.distance_km` (haversine), `trippeople.of` for who is on a trip, `segments.latitude/longitude/geo_precision` for placed bookings, the `airports` table for flights, `geocode.locate_port` for cruise ports, `home.point` for Home.

## Scope

- `waypoint/domain/photomatch.py`: typed inputs (`PhotoIn`: instant UTC, lat/lon or None, person id; `TripWindow`: trip id, start and end instants, list of `SegmentPoint` with segment id, kind, start and end instants, lat/lon); `window(trip, live_segments)` per the design (segment instants padded by `PAD`, dates fallback for visit-only trips); `match(photo, windows, home) -> Match` with `match` in {`place`, `time`, `far`, `ambiguous`, `home`, `none`}, `trip_id`, `segment_id`, `distance_km`; the thresholds as module constants with the decided values.
- `waypoint/domain/photos.py` (new, this issue starts it): `where_was(points, instant) -> (lat, lon, segment_id) | None` per the design (active segment, else last ended within `GAP`, else next starting within `GAP`; a flight under way gives None), and `candidate_windows(conn, person_id)` that reads the person's trips through `trippeople.of` and `visibility.visible_segments(conn, Viewer(person_id))`, builds `SegmentPoint`s (airports for flights, stored points for the rest, ports for cruises) and returns `TripWindow`s. No photo rows are read or written here.

## Out of scope

Writing rows, clusters, the sync loop ({{PHOTOS-SYNC}}), routes ({{PHOTOS-API}}).

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Table-driven tests cover: one window with GPS near, far and in between; no GPS in one window; two nested windows settled by GPS; two nested windows without GPS (shorter wins); equal windows (ambiguous); photo inside Home radius inside a window (home); photo outside every window (none); padding at both ends; a visit-only trip's date window in its zone; `where_was` for a stay, a gap after checkout within and beyond `GAP`, and a flight under way.
- [ ] `match` and `where_was` are deterministic and take no connection; `candidate_windows` is the only function touching the database and is tested with `own_database`.
- [ ] No segment or trip query outside `waypoint/domain/visibility.py`'s helpers and `trippeople.of` (Semgrep `waypoint-trip-visibility` applies to `waypoint/server/`; keep the domain honest anyway).
- [ ] `make check` passes with strict mypy.

## Tests

`tests/test_photomatch.py` (pure cases), `tests/test_photos_where.py` (`where_was` and `candidate_windows` on a seeded database).

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on (candidates come only from the person's own trip membership). Check added: a test that a trip the person merely booked or received an email for is not a candidate.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-DECISIONS}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).

title: feat: Immich sources: encrypted key storage, sources API, lapsed-access sweep
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Proxy and access rules](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#proxy-and-access-rules) (the Sources paragraph) and [Settings screen](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#settings-screen). Read `SECURITY.md` first. Secrets are decrypted only in the storage layer, `oidc.py`, `domain/loyalty.py` and `providers/gmail.py` (Semgrep `waypoint-decrypt`), so a storage module hands the provider its key. `waypoint/storage/stored_mail.py` is the pattern for a storage module that encrypts a column; `waypoint/providers/gmail.py`'s `end_lapsed` and `jobs.sweep_lapsed` are the pattern for ending access when its owner can no longer sign in (AGENTS.md, "Access that outlives the person").

Routes are declared in `waypoint/server/routes.py`, typed in `waypoint/server/contract.py` (then `make api-contract`), validated through `waypoint/validate.py`, and need a docs page: add `docs/src/content/docs/start/photos.md` and map `photos` and `photo-sources` to it in `tools/feature_map.py`'s `AREA_DOCS` (then `make feature-map`). `waypoint/server/api/ai.py` shows saving a setting that holds a key; `api/mailboxes.py` shows owner-only routes.

## Scope

- `waypoint/storage/photo_sources.py`: `save(conn, person_id, owner_sub, url, key, label)`, `set_key`, `set_paused`, `remove`, `source_for_provider(conn, source_id) -> providers.immich.Source` (the one place the key is decrypted), `list_all(conn)` (never returning the key), `mark(conn, source_id, status, error)`, `end_lapsed(conn, now)`. Register `"photo_sources": ("api_key",)` in `secretbox.SECRET_COLUMNS` and add the table to `secretbox.encrypt_stored`'s rotation loop with its own warning text.
- `waypoint/server/api/photos.py` (started here): `GET /api/photo-sources` (every source: id, person_id, host, label, status, last_sync, last_error, photo count, `mine`), `POST /api/photo-sources` (person_id from People, url through `immich.clean_url`, key, label; refuses a duplicate person+url; pings Immich before saving and answers the fixed sentence for `Refused`/`Unavailable`), `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}` (new key, label, paused; only `owner_sub` or the household in local mode, else 404), `DELETE /api/photo-sources/{id}` (same rule), `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/test` (ping with the saved or a supplied key, reply the Immich user's name without saving), `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/sync` (returns 202 and a `started` flag; the job itself is {{PHOTOS-SYNC}}, so here it only records a `sync_requested` marker the job reads, or calls a hook that is a no-op until then).
- Contract types `PhotoSource`, `PhotoSourceBody`, `PhotoSourceTest`, `PhotoSources` in `contract.py`; add `/api/photo-sources` and `/api/photos` to `BLOCKED` in `waypoint/server/mcp_access.py`.
- `jobs.sweep_lapsed` calls `photo_sources.end_lapsed` next to `gmail.end_lapsed` and logs the count.
- Docs: `docs/src/content/docs/start/photos.md` with Setting up (where to make an Immich key, which permissions), What Waypoint reads and keeps, Who sees what, and a Privacy paragraph; link it from the sidebar where `start/gmail.md` is linked.

## Out of scope

The sync loop, the matcher, the trip photos reply, the proxy, the Settings UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] The key is encrypted at rest (a row read with raw SQL shows `enc:v1:`), never in any reply (`GET /api/photo-sources` and the test reply are asserted free of it), never in a log line (`no_leaks` with the key as a canary around save, test, a failing ping and `end_lapsed`).
- [ ] `secretbox.encrypt_stored` re-encrypts a source key saved under an old key (test with `WAYPOINT_SECRET_KEY_OLD`).
- [ ] A member who did not connect a source gets 404 from edit, delete, test and sync of it; the owner gets 200; in local mode (no OIDC) everything answers.

IDs are for the household (an API key is a secret like a mailbox token: encrypted, masked, never logged). Access that outlives the person. Checks added: Semgrep `waypoint-decrypt` already covers the storage module; the rotation and `no_leaks` tests; the `BLOCKED` entries.

title: feat: photo sync job: page Immich per trip window, write rows, match
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Sync job](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#sync-job) and [Data model](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#data-model) (`photo_trip_syncs`). Background jobs live in `waypoint/server/jobs.py` and take the `today` they are given (Semgrep `waypoint-today-in-jobs`); the mail scan (`waypoint/domain/mail/scan.py`, `jobs.scan_mailboxes`, `jobs.scan_now`) is the pattern for a budgeted run that resumes from a cursor, a per-source lock, and a counts-only summary.

## Scope

- `waypoint/domain/photosync.py`: `run(conn, source_id, provider, now, *, full=False) -> Summary` doing, per the design: build the person's windows (`photos.candidate_windows`), reconcile `photo_trip_syncs` (new trip → full window fetch; moved window → full fetch; left trip → drop the row and null those photos' `trip_id`), page `provider.search` with `takenAfter`/`takenBefore` and `updatedAfter` cursor, upsert `photos` rows (time, GPS, state, country, `seen`; one row per asset even when windows overlap), run `photomatch.match` on every `auto` row touched and on all `auto` rows of the source when any window changed, set `location_source` and the inferred point via `photos.where_was` for rows without GPS, update cursors and `last_sync`, and under `TIME_BUDGET` stop cleanly leaving cursors so the next run continues. `full=True` (or `PHOTOS_LAST_RELIST` older than `FULL_RELIST_DAYS`) fetches without cursors and deletes rows not `seen` this run. 429 backs off for the run; `Refused` marks the source and stops; `Unavailable` marks `unreachable` and keeps the previous status text if it was already failing (don't clear a warning on a half-failed run).
- `jobs.py`: `PHOTO_SYNC_EVERY` and `PHOTO_SYNC_FIRST` constants with the decided values, `sync_photos()` over sources with status `ok`/`unreachable` (skip `refused`, `off`), and `sync_photos_now(source_id)` started by `POST /api/photo-sources/{id}/sync` from {{PHOTOS-SOURCES}} in a daemon thread with a per-source running flag.
- Summary logged through `monitoring.log` as counts only: sources, pages, assets seen, new, matched by kind, inferred, ambiguous, deleted, budget hit.

## Out of scope

Clusters and the trip photos reply ({{PHOTOS-API}}), the proxy, UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] With a fake provider serving fixture pages: a first run writes rows only inside trip windows, a second run with no changes fetches only with cursors and writes nothing, a trip whose dates moved is re-fetched in full, a photo updated in Immich (GPS added) is re-matched from `time`+`inferred` to `place`+`exif`, an owner-decided row keeps its `trip_id` and `hidden` across re-sync, a full re-list deletes a row the provider no longer returns, and the budget stop leaves cursors that the next run resumes from.
- [ ] A `Refused` provider marks the source `refused` and the next scheduled run skips it; `Unavailable` keeps the last good `last_sync`.
- [ ] No log line or exception text carries an asset id together with a trip name, a coordinate or a place (`no_leaks` with canaries in the fixture).
- [ ] `make check` passes; `make test-pg` run (the job writes settings).

## Tests

`tests/test_photosync.py` with a fake `providers.immich` and `own_database`; `tests/test_jobs.py` additions for scheduling and the per-source lock.

## Promises and checks

Private data in logs (counts only). You see the trips you're on (windows come from the person's own trips). Check added: the `no_leaks` sync test.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SOURCES}}, {{PHOTOS-MATCH}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).

title: feat: trip photos reply with clusters, Needs-a-look list and owner actions
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Proxy and access rules](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#proxy-and-access-rules) and [Map and stats](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#map-and-stats) (Clusters). Every trip read goes through `waypoint/domain/visibility.py` (`visible_trip`), and a trip the viewer can't see answers 404 (Semgrep `waypoint-trip-visibility`, `tests/test_trip_roads.py` shows the stranger test). `api_trip_places` in `waypoint/server/api/trips.py` is the shape to copy for a per-trip read.

## Scope

- `waypoint/domain/photos.py` additions: `for_trip(conn, viewer, trip_id) -> TripPhotos | None` (None when the trip isn't visible; rows with `trip_id` = this trip, `match` in {`place`, `time`, `far`}, hidden rows only when the viewer is that library's person; ordered by `taken_utc`), `clusters(rows)` per the design (greedy by time within `CLUSTER` km, centroid, count, first and last local time, cover id, `inferred` when all are, capped at 400 by merging the smallest neighbours), `needs_a_look(conn, viewer)` (the viewer's own libraries' rows with `match` in {`ambiguous`, `far`}, each with its candidate trips' id and name), `decide(conn, viewer, photo_id, trip_id | None, hidden | None)` (only the library's person; `trip_id` must be a trip they are on; sets `decided_by = owner`).
- Routes in `waypoint/server/api/photos.py`: `GET /api/trips/{id}/photos` → `TripPhotos` {`photos`: [`TripPhoto`], `clusters`: [`PhotoCluster`], `counts`: {total, located, inferred, far, hidden}, `people`: [{person_id, count}]}; `GET /api/photos/review` → `PhotoReview`; `POST /api/photos/{id}` with body {`trip_id`?, `hidden`?} through `waypoint/validate.py` → the updated `TripPhoto`. `TripPhoto` carries Waypoint's photo id, person_id, kind, taken_local, zone label (the segment's zone when `taken_offset` is null), latitude, longitude, location_source, segment_id, match, distance_km, cluster index, hidden; never the Immich asset id or the source URL.
- Contract types in `contract.py`; `make api-contract`; the routes are already under `BLOCKED` prefixes from {{PHOTOS-SOURCES}} (`/api/photos`), and `/api/trips/{id}/photos` is added to `BLOCKED` here so an assistant's `get_trip` never reaches it.
- Docs: extend `start/photos.md` with "On a trip", "Needs a look" and "Who sees what".

## Out of scope

Pixels (that is {{PHOTOS-PROXY}}), the sync, UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A member on the trip gets the trip's photos from every library; a member who merely booked a segment of it (visible trip) also gets them (same as costs); a stranger gets 404 with the same text as a missing trip; an assistant gets the blocked reply.
- [ ] A hidden photo is absent for everyone but its library's person, who sees it with `hidden: true`; `ambiguous` and `home` rows never appear in a trip's reply.
- [ ] `decide` refuses another person's photo (404), refuses a `trip_id` the person is not on (400 with a fixed sentence), and a re-sync afterwards leaves the row alone (`decided_by = owner`).
- [ ] Clusters: a fixture of 1,000 photos along a line clusters to the expected count, inferred-only clusters are flagged, and the 400 cap merges correctly.
- [ ] The reply never contains an Immich asset id or source URL (asserted with canaries), and `make check` passes including `tests/test_every_route.py`.

## Tests

`tests/test_photos_api.py` (visibility, hidden, decide, blocked), `tests/test_photo_clusters.py` (pure).

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on. Checks added: the stranger-404 and assistant-blocked tests for each route; the no-asset-id canary test.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}}, {{PHOTOS-MATCH}}

## Model

Fable (security: per-member visibility is the core of this issue).

title: feat: thumbnail, preview and original streaming from Immich with access checks
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Proxy and access rules](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#proxy-and-access-rules). Read `SECURITY.md`. `api_segment_code` and `api_segment_email_image` in `waypoint/server/api/trips.py` with `image_response` in `waypoint/server/common.py` are the pattern for an authenticated image route (CSP `default-src 'none'; sandbox`, 404 for a stranger, blocked for assistants, listed in `NOT_JSON` in `tests/test_every_route.py`). `Response.stream` in `common.py` is how a large body is streamed. `providers/mailimages.py` shows chunked reads under caps.

## Scope

- `waypoint/domain/photos.py`: `servable(conn, viewer, photo_id) -> (row, source) | None` (row exists, not hidden for this viewer, and either `visible_trip` for its `trip_id` or the viewer is the library's person; `ambiguous`/`home`/`none` rows only for that person), and `placeholder(asset_id, size) -> (content_type, bytes)`: a deterministic gradient PNG (reuse the PNG writer in `domain/demo.py`, moved to a small shared helper if needed) at 256 px for `thumbnail` and 1280 px for `preview`, used when the source's `url` is `demo` so no connection is opened.
- Routes: `GET /api/photos/{id}/thumbnail`, `GET /api/photos/{id}/preview`, `GET /api/photos/{id}/original` in `waypoint/server/api/photos.py`. Thumbnail and preview fetch through `providers.immich.thumbnail` with `photo_sources.source_for_provider`, caps 2 MB and 10 MB, sniffed content type (`image/webp`, `image/jpeg`, `image/png`; anything else is 404), reply `image_response` plus `Cache-Control: private, max-age=86400` and an ETag of (asset id, size) with `If-None-Match` → 304. Original streams `providers.immich.open_original` in chunks under a 10-minute budget with the sniffed type (`image/*` or `video/mp4`, `video/quicktime`), `Content-Disposition: inline`, no size cap. An Immich 404/410 deletes the row and answers 404; 401/403 marks the source `refused` and answers 404; a network error answers 503 with a fixed sentence.
- Nothing from Immich's reply headers is forwarded; the key is never in a URL; nothing is written to disk or the database except the row deletion and status marks.
- `NOT_JSON` entries for the three routes; they are under the `/api/photos` `BLOCKED` prefix already (assert it).
- Docs: `start/photos.md` "How pictures reach your browser" paragraph.

## Out of scope

Resizing or caching pixels on the server, range requests for video scrubbing (note it as a follow-up if the owner wants seek), UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A member on the trip gets 200 with the sniffed image type and the CSP; a stranger, an assistant, a hidden photo (for a non-owner) and an unknown id all get the same 404 text; the library's person gets their own `ambiguous` photo.
- [ ] The upstream request carries `x-api-key` and the asset id only in the provider; the key appears in no log, reply header or error (`no_leaks` with the key and the source host as canaries around success, 401, 404 and a timeout).
- [ ] A body over the cap, a non-image type and an Immich 500 each answer without leaking Immich's text; an Immich 404 deletes the row.
- [ ] `ETag`/`If-None-Match` round-trips to 304; `Cache-Control` is `private`.
- [ ] A `demo` source answers thumbnails and previews with no connection attempt (test with `tls.urlopen` patched to fail).
- [ ] `make check` passes, `tests/test_every_route.py` is satisfied (`NOT_JSON`, docs page).

## Tests

`tests/test_photo_proxy.py` with a patched provider and `own_database`; the canary and `no_leaks` cases above; the 304 case.

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on; Private data in logs; the proposed new promise line "Photos stay in Immich" (add it to AGENTS.md's list in this PR, naming these tests as its checks). Checks added: the tests above; the `BLOCKED` assertion.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SOURCES}}

## Model

Fable (security: the proxy and its access checks).

title: feat: per-trip summary (days, nights, distance, states and countries, photos)
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Map and stats](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#map-and-stats) (Stats). Waypoint has household stats in `waypoint/domain/stats.py` (`distance_km`, `_nights`, `_days`, `countries_of`) and the route's road legs in `waypoint/domain/tripmap.py` (`road_legs`, `roads.Route.miles`), but no per-trip figures. `GET /api/trips/<built-in function id>/places` and `api_trip_places` are the pattern for a visibility-checked per-trip read. The household's distance unit is `settings_keys.DISTANCE_UNIT`, read by `api_distance_unit`.

## Scope

- `waypoint/domain/tripstats.py`: `summary(conn, viewer, trip_id) -> TripSummary | None` with `days` (trip dates inclusive), `nights` (union of hotel and cruise nights), `distance_km` split into `flight_km` (great-circle between the flight's airports, cancelled excluded) and `road_km` (highway legs from `tripmap.road_legs` where found, else straight-line between consecutive placed stays and rentals in time order; `road_estimated: true` when any leg fell back), `states` (US state names from segment addresses through `geocode._state`/`regions`, visit `details[trips.STATE]`, and the photos' `state` where `country` is the US) and `countries` (airport countries, `stats.countries_of` for stay cities, visit destinations, photos' `country`), `photos` {total, inferred}, and `kinds` counts. Everything reads segments through `visibility.visible_segments`.
- Route `GET /api/trips/{id}/summary` in `waypoint/server/api/trips.py` (next to `api_trip_places`), contract type `TripSummary`, `make api-contract`, docs in `start/trips.md` ("A trip's numbers") with a link from `start/photos.md`; add it to `READABLE` in `mcp_access.py` only if the owner wants assistants to see it (default: not listed, so blocked by the existing rules for unlisted reads).

## Out of scope

State lines crossed by the route (needs data Waypoint doesn't bundle; see Decisions item 11). UI.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] A fixture trip with two flights, three stays (two with addresses in different states), a rental and photos with Immich states yields the expected days, nights, km split, state and country lists (sorted, deduplicated, names not codes) and photo counts; a trip with no placed segment yields zeros and empty lists without error.
- [ ] A stranger gets 404; cancelled segments count for nothing.
- [ ] `make check` passes (strict mypy, contract, feature map, docs).

## Tests

`tests/test_tripstats.py` on a seeded database; the route in `tests/test_trip_summary.py` (visibility, empty trip).

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on. Check added: the stranger test on the route.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).

title: feat: demo photo sources and rows, so make verify shows photos without Immich
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Proxy and access rules](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#proxy-and-access-rules) (Demo paragraph). `python run.py demo` seeds `waypoint/domain/demo.py`; `make verify` (`waypoint/verify.py`) runs the app on that data with the network blocked (`HTTPS_PROXY=http://127.0.0.1:9`) and a frozen clock, and `frontend/verify/verify.mjs` warms each trip's map first. A `demo` source serves generated placeholders through `photos.placeholder` ({{PHOTOS-PROXY}}).

## Scope

- In `demo.seed`: one `photo_sources` row per demo household member (`url = "demo"`, `api_key` an encrypted placeholder like the demo mailbox token, status `ok`, `last_sync` set), and photo rows over the existing demo trips: the family road trip (`_family_road_trip`) with GPS photos near each stay plus a cluster on a day out, several without GPS (inferred to the stay), one `far`; a past flight trip with airport and hotel photos; the current trip with a few photos up to the frozen clock; one `ambiguous` and one `far` row for the "Needs a look" screen; a hidden one. Made-up ids like `demo-0001`; times inside each trip's window computed from `today`, as the other demo helpers do; coordinates offset from the segments' stored points so the matcher would agree.
- A `photo_trip_syncs` row per (source, trip) so a real sync is never attempted against `demo`; `photosync` skips `url == "demo"` sources (one-line guard).
- `demo._rows` counts the new tables; `README.md`'s demo section mentions photos in one sentence.

## Out of scope

Any UI (the rows just need to exist for the UI issues' screenshots). Real Immich.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] `python run.py demo` on an empty data dir seeds sources and photos and prints the new row count; `GET /api/trips/{id}/photos` for the road trip returns clusters with at least one inferred-only cluster and one `far` photo; `GET /api/photos/{id}/thumbnail` answers a PNG with no network.
- [ ] `make verify` completes with the network blocked (no new notes about failed requests in `artifacts/verify/`).
- [ ] `make check` passes; `tests/test_demo.py` (or the existing demo test) asserts the counts and that every demo photo's `taken_utc` lies inside its trip's window.

## Tests

`tests/test_demo.py` additions; a `verify` run locally (output in the PR).

## Promises and checks

Personal data in the repo: demo rows are invented (ids, coordinates near made-up stays, no real places beyond the airports the demo already uses). Check: none new.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}}, {{PHOTOS-PROXY}}

## Model

Sonnet: follows the demo module's existing patterns and the design's row shapes; mechanical once {{PHOTOS-SCHEMA}} and {{PHOTOS-PROXY}} exist.

title: feat: trip page photo strip, gallery by day and photo viewer
body: ## Context [docs/PHOTOS.md, Map and stats](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#map-and-stats) and the signed-off design in `docs/design/photos/` ({{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}). title: feat: photo cluster pins on the trip map, linked to the gallery and the replay
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Map and stats](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#map-and-stats) (Map) and the signed-off design ({{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}). The map is `RouteReplayMap.svelte` fed by `RouteReplay.svelte` with the geometry helpers in `lib/route-replay.ts` (`routeProjection`, `positions`, `stopDates`, `activeStop`), d3-geo projections and bundled atlases; `lib/map.ts` has `dotRadius` for sized dots. The map currently appears only for an ended trip with two placeable stops (`eligible` in `RouteReplay.svelte`).

## Scope

- `lib/route-replay.ts`: `pinsOf(clusters, projection)` (position, radius from count via a `dotRadius`-style curve, `inferred`), `pinLit(cluster, stops, progress)` so a pin lights when the replay passes the cluster's first time, and the projection includes cluster points in its fit (`routeProjection` takes an optional `more` list, as `flownBounds` does in `lib/map.ts`).
- `RouteReplayMap.svelte`: a pins layer (filled for GPS clusters, hollow for inferred-only, count label past a threshold the design sets), accessible as buttons with a name like "12 photos near Moab, 14–16 Jun"; tap or Enter selects the cluster and the gallery scrolls to its first photo (an event the Trip page handles); a selected pin shows the cover thumbnail in a small callout if the design has one.
- `RouteReplay.svelte`: show the map when there are at least one cluster or two stops; show replay controls only when the route is replayable (the current `eligible` rule); with reduced motion every pin is lit.
- Docs: `start/trips.md` "Replaying a past trip's route" gains the pins paragraph; `start/photos.md` links to it.

## Out of scope

Map tiles, clustering on the client (the server clusters), per-photo pins.

## Acceptance criteria

title: feat: Needs a look: pick a trip for ambiguous photos, review far ones, hide
body:
## Context

[docs/PHOTOS.md, Matching](https://github.com/AnthonyPluth/Waypoint/blob/main/docs/PHOTOS.md#matching) (ambiguous and far), `GET /api/photos/review` and `POST /api/photos/<built-in function id>` from {{PHOTOS-API}}, and the signed-off design ({{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}), which decided where this lives (under the trip, in the source card, or both). Only the library's person sees and acts on their own photos. `ActionMenu.svelte` and the Review page's grouping are the patterns for a small decision queue.

## Scope

- `PhotosNeedsLook.svelte`: a list of the viewer's own photos needing a look, grouped as the design says (Which trip? and Far from the bookings), each with the thumbnail, the local time, the candidate trips as buttons (Pick) and Hide; counts in the heading; an empty state.
- Mount it where the design put it: in `PhotosSection.svelte`'s source card and, if chosen, on the trip page with only that trip's candidates.
- Docs: `start/photos.md` "Needs a look".

## Out of scope

Bulk actions, undo (a decision is reversible by picking again), anything for other people's photos.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] UI matches the signed-off design in {{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}. Any change to layout, flow or visual style needs owner sign-off before merge; include screenshots in the PR.
- [ ] Vitest covers: grouping, Pick calls `POST /api/photos/{id}` with the trip id and removes the row from the list, Hide likewise, the empty state, and that nothing renders for a viewer with no library.
- [ ] `make verify settings` (and `trip` if mounted there) at both widths on demo data (the demo has one ambiguous and one far photo); images committed.
- [ ] `make check` passes.

## Tests

`PhotosNeedsLook.svelte.test.ts`; `PhotosSection.svelte.test.ts` addition; `make verify settings trip`.

## Promises and checks

You see the trips you're on (the API already restricts to the person's own photos and trips; the UI never offers a trip the API didn't list). Check: the component tests.

## Depends on

{{PHOTOS-DESIGN}}, {{PHOTOS-API}}, {{PHOTOS-PROXY}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-GALLERY}}, {{PHOTOS-UI-SETTINGS}}

## Model

Opus (owner's routing for this feature).
